_comment: Reviewed security-scan exceptions: existing findings with tracked follow-ups and intentionally public actions, not a snooze. Anything not listed here fails CI. Removing an entry once fixed is required: the scan prints a 'stale' warning when a baselined entry no longer matches.

known.reason: Reads DATABASE_URL with no server-only guard. Not reachable from any client component today; the guard is hardening, and adding the server-only package is a separate change.

getApiKey() reads BALLDONTLIE_API_KEY with no server-only guard. Season config moved to lib/stats/season.ts, so no client component reaches this module any more; the guard is hardening, and adding the server-only package is a separate change.

signUp and resendConfirmation back the signup and sign-in forms and must work signed out, so the missing session check is correct. isUsernameTaken moved to lib/auth/usernameTaken.ts and is no longer an action. Signup and /api/username-available share a fail-closed Postgres-backed per-client request budget before querying usernames.

requestPasswordReset backs the forgot-password form and must work signed out, since the user cannot sign in. It only asks Supabase to mail a recovery link, reads no account data and writes nothing itself. It answers success for unknown addresses so it does not reveal which emails are registered, and Supabase rate limits recovery emails per address.

loadFantasyTrendLogs is an intentionally public, read-only action for the signed-out Players Fantasy tab. It selects only NBA box-score fields, never reads account data or writes, validates positive integer player ids, caps requests at one page (100 players), and caches results for 300 seconds. Session gating would break public rolling charts. Re-review this exception before adding exports, private data, or writes to this module.
